bathymetry.title: Merged bathymetry of the Santa Barbara Channel, California

landMask.title: Santa Barbara, California 1/3 arc-second MHW Coastal Digital Elevation Model
landMask.agency: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information
landMask.use: Binary land/water mask and zero-elevation shoreline only

processing.outputGrid: One 1800 by 1800 WGS84 grid for land, shoreline, contours, and features
processing.contours: USGS DS 702 raster reprojected once, masked by NOAA MHW water, then contoured at 10 m intervals without decorative geometry
processing.land: Sentinel true color masked by NOAA MHW land and dilated 2 output pixels offshore
processing.clipping: Geographic sources buffered to the registered frame; browser clipping occurs only at the outer rounded hero viewport

limitations: DS 702 is a historical 10 m compilation relative to NAVD88.
The NOAA MHW DEM is used only for the display mask and shoreline, not to create or fill bathymetric contours.
Resolution does not equal positional or vertical accuracy.
